title: Properties of multi-qubit variational quantum states representing weighted graphs and their computing with quantum programming
summary: We study multi-qubit variational quantum states that can be considered as vertex- and edge-weighted graph. These states are constructed as single-layer variational circuits with $RX$ rotations and $RZZ$ entangling gates, corresponding to graphs of arbitrary structure. In general case of quantum graph states of arbitrary structure we derive the geometric measure of entanglement and evaluate quantum correlators.
